svg.desc: Warm WSS median round trips per second: Scrapanium Bend 5988; matched curl_cffi 6045. Five shuffled runs of 1,000 round trips, 30-byte binary payload. Both curl-impersonate 2.2.3, Chrome 146. Python also compares returned payloads. Linux/WSL2 loopback only; startup, TLS/HTTP upgrade and close excluded. Source: benchmarks/results/websocket.json.
